location: Retail grocery, cold storage, transport and healthcare cold chains

confirmed_facts.text: CISA, the FBI, HHS, USDA and DOT published a joint TLP:CLEAR fact sheet on 5 November urging owners to harden industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems.
The agencies said successful exploitation could change temperatures and cause fire hazards, loss of inventory and equipment damage.

reported_claims.text: In October, refrigeration controllers at an estimated 250 to 350 French supermarkets were compromised, with attackers activating defrost functions and raising temperatures.
Supermarket chains in France and elsewhere in Europe destroyed food stock after systems administered by a refrigeration provider were compromised.

unknowns: Identity and motive of the actors
Number of organisations affected outside Europe
reassessment_triggers: Reported harm to medicine or blood supplies
A CVE or KEV listing for an exploited controller

title: Global cyber campaign against industrial refrigeration and cold-chain systems
summary: On 5 November 2026 CISA, the FBI, HHS, USDA and the Department of Transportation issued a joint fact sheet warning of malicious cyber activity targeting industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems globally. Attackers are exploiting unpatched or internet-accessible temperature controllers and refrigeration management systems. The warning followed compromises of supermarket refrigeration in France and other European countries in October that forced stock to be destroyed.
impact_assessment: Observed: food stock destroyed at European supermarkets. Potential: spoilage of food and temperature-sensitive medicine, fire hazards and equipment damage across food, agriculture, transport and healthcare cold chains.
priority_rationale: HIGH: confirmed, ongoing activity against systems with physical consequences across several critical sectors, documented by five US agencies; the actors are not publicly identified.
monitoring_actions: Inventory internet-exposed refrigeration and temperature controllers
Check ThreatWatch for exploited controller vulnerabilities
